title: On the Wedderburn decomposition of the total ring of quotients of certain Iwasawa algebras II
summary: Let $\mathcal G\simeq H\rtimesΓ$ be the semidirect product of a finite group $H$ and $Γ\simeq\mathbb Z_p$. Let $ F/\mathbb Q_p$ be a finite extension with ring of integers $\mathcal O_F$. Then the total ring of quotients $\mathcal Q^F(\mathcal G)$ of the completed group ring $\mathcal O_F[[\mathcal G]]$ is semisimple artinian. We determine its Wedderburn decomposition in full generality in terms of the Wedderburn decomposition of the group ring $ F[H]$.
